2608.26983.title: GraphMemix: Query-Aware Evidence Forests for Long-Term Multimodal Agent Memory
2608.26983.paper_summary: Organizing long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging because existing methods either suffer from expensive question-agnostic offline summaries or naive embedding similarity matching that introduces incomplete and redundant context. To address these issues, we propose GraphMemix, a combinatorial-optimization graph memory framework that models memory organization as query-aware evidence-forest construction. Specifically, our method consists of three key components:(1) candidate graph construction, which expands multi-view seed memories through schema and semantic relations to acquire query-aware original context; (2) evidence utility and activation costs, which decouples direct memory support from anchor-conditioned relation verification to suppress redundant or conflicting information; and (3) forest optimization, which jointly selects a forest-format memory context under a maximum evidence budget and its reliable relational structure. By organizing memory into a query-relevant subgraph, the method avoids substantial lifecycle cost and recovers low-similarity complementary evidence. Experimental results across four long-term multimodal memory benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements with different foundation models and establish a new Pareto frontier between accuracy and lifecycle cost.
2608.26983.paper_summary_zh: 組織多模態代理的長期記憶仍然具有挑戰性，因為現有的方法要麼面臨昂貴的與問題無關的離線摘要，要麼是引入不完整和冗餘上下文的天真嵌入相似性匹配。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了GraphMemix，一個組合優化的圖形記憶框架，將記憶組織建模為基於查詢的證據森林構建。具體而言，我們的方法由三個關鍵組件組成：(1) 候選圖構建，通過模式和語義關係擴展多視角種子記憶，以獲取基於查詢的原始上下文；(2) 證據效用和激活成本，將直接記憶支持與錨點條件關係驗證解耦，以抑制冗餘或衝突的信息；以及 (3) 森林優化，根據最大證據預算及其可靠的關係結構共同選擇森林格式的記憶上下文。通過將記憶組織成與查詢相關的子圖，該方法避免了巨大的生命週期成本並恢復了低相似度的互補證據。在四個長期多模態記憶基準上的實驗結果顯示，使用不同的基礎模型取得了顯著的改進，並在準確性和生命週期成本之間建立了一個新的帕累托邊界。
